settings.hero_heading: Every Book Preserves a Piece of History.
settings.hero_intro: From a personal library to an independent bookstore, Gilgamesh Books is built on a lifelong fascination with literature and the ideas worth preserving.
settings.story_body:
Gilgamesh Books began long before there was a storefront. It began with a personal library that has grown to approximately 3,000 books—and an enduring curiosity about the written word.

Rare and hard-to-find titles, occult and esoteric literature, banned and challenged works, and science fiction all found their way onto the shelves. Over time, the collector became a bookseller, eager to share unexpected discoveries with readers who appreciate the history behind a book as much as the words within it.
settings.name_eyebrow: AN ANCIENT STORY · AN ENDURING IDEA
settings.name_body:
The name comes from the Epic of Gilgamesh, among the oldest surviving works of literature. Thousands of years after its earliest versions were recorded, its questions about friendship, mortality, and the human experience still speak to us.

That extraordinary survival is the point: stories can travel farther through time than the people who first told them. Books are not merely objects to own. They carry memory, imagination, and human knowledge across generations.
settings.mission_body:
The story of the lost Library of Alexandria remains a powerful reminder of how fragile the written record can be—and how much disappears when knowledge is neglected or destroyed.

Gilgamesh Books exists, in its own small way, to keep books and ideas circulating. Whether a work is obscure, controversial, challenged, forgotten, or simply difficult to find, we believe it deserves the chance to be read and remembered.

Preservation begins with curiosity. Sometimes it begins with a single book.
settings.interests_intro: The most interesting books are not always the easiest to find.
settings.closing_body: For readers, collectors, historians, and the endlessly curious.
